data.body:
Implemented and landed as Gerrit change 2005 -> merged 1ab859777a.

Scope (narrowed after plan-review): only the four RENDERED non-bridge advanced factories were switched to RebarHelpFormatter -- metrics.build, audit.build, bridge_arms.build_fsck, bridge_arms.build_probe. Intercept-group parsers (incl. verify.py) are out of scope: gen_cli_help.py never renders them and gen_cli_reference.py already canonicalizes their live --help cross-version, so pinning them is redundant with an existing design-layer solution.

Evidence:
- Contract test tests/interfaces/contracts/test_parser_formatter_pinned.py (new): iterates help-backed routes, resolves each parser_factory, asserts its formatter subclasses RebarHelpFormatter. RED first for exactly metrics/audit/bridge-fsck/bridge-probe (4 failed), GREEN after the switch (54 passed).
- Regeneration: gen_cli_help.py + gen_cli_reference.py --check rc=0. Only wrapping help drifted -- src/rebar/_cli/help/bridge-fsck.txt and its mirrored block in docs/cli-reference.md moved to the canonical width-80 form; metrics.txt/audit.txt/bridge-probe.txt byte-unchanged.
- Cross-version byte-identity: gen --check rc=0 on py3.12.13 AND py3.13.15 (the argparse-divergent cell). CI confirmed Verified+1 across ubuntu py3.11 / py3.12 / py3.13 and macos py3.13.
- Gates: lint (complexity new=0/increased=0), typecheck (no issues), module-size (no file over 800) all clean.
- Landed both gates green: LLM-Review+1 (PASS) AND Verified+1, submitted MERGED.
